tasks.label: Build FinalProject (x86)
args: call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x86 && cl.exe /Zi /EHsc /nologo /I"${workspaceFolder}\include" /Fe"${workspaceFolder}\FinalProject.exe" "${workspaceFolder}\*.cpp" /link /LIBPATH:"${workspaceFolder}\lib" freeglut.lib glew32.lib FreeImage.lib assimp.lib avcodec.lib avformat.lib avutil.lib swscale.lib swresample.lib
tasks.detail: Builds the FinalProject executable using the Win32 toolchain and project libraries.
